title: Testing
description: Testing ideas — verified here by running Main and matching stdout

exercises.title: Basic test (stdout)
Table cases (stdout)
hints: Implement `multiply` and print three results separated by spaces.

exercises.title: Divide and error (stdout)
exercises.description: Print `ok` if `divide(10,2)` is 5 and `divide(10,0)` is null.
hints: Guard `b == 0` returning `null`; compare with `Integer.valueOf(5)` / `== null` carefully — reference uses `== 5` on autounboxed path.

exercises.title: Error message check (stdout)
exercises.description: If `validate(-5)` throws with `negative` in the message, System.out.println `yes`.
hints: Throw `new IllegalArgumentException("age cannot be negative")` for negatives; catch and check `getMessage().contains("negative")`.

exercises.title: Hot path loop (stdout)
exercises.description: Call `sum(2,3)` ten thousand times, then System.out.println `done`.
